settings.name: columns
settings.doc: Columns, or groups of them (a group's header needs the spans feature; the base keeps its columns).

settings.name: messages
settings.doc: Required (D1): the grid bundles no language.

settings.name: direction
settings.doc: `auto` follows the host's direction, and its changes.

settings.name: headers
settings.doc: `'hidden'`: no header row on screen, kept for screen readers and shown while the keyboard is in it (docs/behaviors/hidden-headers.md, 1.9.0). Live. Default `'shown'`.

settings.name: multiSort
settings.doc: False: one sort only — Shift+click, Shift+Enter and a header part's `toggleSort(true)` act as a plain click (sort.md « One sort only »); the app's own `sort.set` of several is kept. True by default. Fixed.

settings.name: sameRow
settings.doc: A full reload (`rows` again, a server's answer) compares a row kept by id with its new copy: equal, it is unchanged and keeps its old object, so only real changes flash (row-identity-transactions.md « Rows compared by value »; `sameValues` from `@dzgrid/core/compare`). A throw: changed, one warning per load. Fixed.

settings.name: rowHeight
settings.doc: The row height in px at 16 px text, over the density's (owner D1, virtual-scroll.md « Row height »): from 24 to 1 000, grown with the reader's text size; header rows follow unless `headerHeight` is set. Anything else is told (`invalid-setting`, a warning) and the density's height is used. Live.

settings.name: headerHeight
settings.doc: The column headers' row and the column-group rows above it, in px at 16 px text (density.md « Header height », 1.9.0): the same rule as `rowHeight` (24 to 1 000, grown with the text size, else told and ignored); a feature's row under the headers (the filter row) keeps the row height. Absent: the row height. Live. 1.10.0: `{ columns, groups }` sets them apart (« Group rows' height »): `columns` absent the row height, `groups` absent the columns'.

settings.name: selection
settings.type: { readonly mode: 'none' | 'single' | 'multi'; readonly checkbox?: boolean; readonly click?: boolean; readonly keepOnFilter?: boolean; readonly canSelect?: (row: DataNode<T>, selection: SelectionState, context: unknown) => boolean | string }
settings.doc: `keepOnFilter`: false clears the selection when a filter or the search changes (a sort or a page never does); true by default, rows ticked stay ticked even once hidden. `canSelect` (step 21, docs/behaviors/selection-rules.md, needs `rules()`): whether a row may join the selection; true allows, false refuses, a string refuses and is said ('' refuses unsaid). Never asked to untick; its `selection` keeps changing while one action is vetted (copy it to keep it).

settings.name: context
settings.doc: The application's own context (step 21): handed to every part (`context`), `canSelect`, the export's `canExport` and the tooltip callback. Live; a new value is a new identity (pass a new object).

settings.name: rowClass
settings.doc: Classes for a data row from its data (showcase themes step 6, cell-class.md): space-separated, null for none; asked when the row is bound again (another row, new data, columns, language, context or rule). Live. Keep the same function from one update to the next: a new one (an inline arrow) binds every row again.

settings.name: busy
settings.doc: The host is reloading rows it keeps on screen (a poll, its own arrows; 1.4.0, overlays.md « Busy bar »): `aria-busy` on the grid at once, a thin bar under the header after 200 ms (held 400 ms once shown), never with the loading overlay. A server's request with rows kept shows it by itself. Live; nothing announced.

settings.name: label
settings.doc: The grid's accessible name, already translated; the bundle's `grid.label` otherwise.

settings.name: injectStyles
settings.doc: False when the host loads the layout CSS itself (strict CSP).

settings.name: overscan
settings.type: { readonly rows?: number; readonly cols?: number }

settings.name: searchWarmup
settings.doc: `idle` prepares the quick search after each load, in idle time, so the first keystroke is instant — at the cost of holding the search caches (627 bytes a row measured on dataset A's ten text columns; budget for the owner, D13). Off by default (D13).

settings.name: parts
settings.doc: Parts by name: a column says `ui: { cell: 'statusBadge' }`, or a part replaces a default for a type (`'cell.number'`). One registry per grid.

settings.name: source
settings.doc: A server's rows: `sourceRows(data, …)` from `@dzgrid/core/server`. Live: another source asks again.

settings.name: operations
settings.doc: Where filter, search, sort and page run (`'server'`, `'client'`, or per operation). Set once.

settings.name: pagination
settings.doc: Paged in the browser: one page of the filtered, sorted rows at a time. Set once.

settings.name: filterKinds
settings.doc: Custom filter kinds (docs/behaviors/filter-custom.md), for the browser's filter and a server's. Set once.

settings.name: clock
settings.doc: The clock (milliseconds since 1970 UTC) date shortcuts count from (filter-relative.md); `Date.now` by default. Set once.

settings.name: fullWidth
settings.doc: Rows drawn as one cell across the whole width (a title, a note): true, or the part that draws it. Needs the spans feature; the base ignores it.

settings.name: motion
settings.doc: False: no motion (`@dzgrid/dom/motion-gsap` stops, `data-motion="off"` on the root for the theme). Live.

settings.name: theme
settings.doc: CSS variables written on the grid's root, by typed keys (`{ rowOddBg: '…', headerWeight: 500 }`; presentation-settings.md 20–22, 1.9.0). Needs `theming()` from `@dzgrid/dom/theme`; a bad key or value is told (`invalid-setting`) and skipped. Live.

settings.name: icons
settings.doc: The application's own icons for the grid's marks (presentation-settings.md 17–19). Needs `theming()`. Live.

settings.name: features
settings.doc: Optional features (`filters()`, `pagination()`…), set up once with the grid.

columns.name: id
columns.doc: Required and stable: the key of the column's state.

columns.name: field
columns.doc: A path into the row (`a.b.c`); defaults to the id when no `value` is given.

columns.name: header
columns.doc: Already translated by the host.

columns.name: headerShort
columns.doc: A shorter header, without unit, where room is short (the pivot's created headers and chips, pivot.md 38); absent: `header`.

columns.name: hideable
columns.doc: `false`: the column menu's « Hide » is disabled for it (Phase 6 step 3, column-menu.md 13).

columns.name: menu
columns.doc: `false`: no column menu (no ⋮, no right-click menu; its keys left to the page). Phase 6 step 3.

columns.name: chooser
columns.doc: `false`: left out of the column chooser's list (still hideable by the menu). Phase 6 step 4, columns-chooser.md 6.

columns.name: groupable
columns.doc: `false`: rows are never grouped by it (`@dzgrid/core/grouping`, row-grouping.md 14; the zone and the menu refuse it). Phase 7.

columns.name: aggFunc
columns.doc: Its total on group rows, footers and the grand total (`@dzgrid/core/grouping`, aggregation.md 2–3): a built-in, or a function of the group's values. The grouping's own `aggFuncs` win over it. Phase 7.

columns.name: total
columns.doc: Its total in the totals row of a flat grid (`@dzgrid/dom/totals-row`, docs/behaviors/totals-row.md; 1.9.0): the same built-ins and rules as `aggFunc`, or a function of the column's values (`level` null). Needs that feature.

columns.name: headerVertical
columns.doc: Its header's title written upwards (`@dzgrid/dom/vertical-headers`, docs/behaviors/vertical-headers.md; 1.9.0): the header row grows to the longest such title. Needs that feature; keys and screen readers unchanged.

columns.name: headerWrap
columns.doc: Its header's title on several lines (`@dzgrid/dom/wrapped-headers`, docs/behaviors/header-wrap.md; 1.10.0): the column headers' row grows to the tallest wrapped title, at most `maxLines`. Needs that feature.

columns.name: collapsePriority
columns.doc: With `@dzgrid/dom/responsive` (docs/behaviors/responsive-columns.md; 1.9.0): when the columns do not fit the view, which collapse under their rows first — the highest first, the last on screen among equals; 0 never. Default 1.

columns.name: filter
columns.type: false | { readonly kind?: string; readonly floating?: boolean; readonly debounceMs?: number; readonly ops?: readonly string[]; readonly optionPart?: string; readonly exclude?: false; readonly start?: 'all' | 'empty'; readonly selectAll?: boolean; readonly maxConditions?: number; readonly matchCase?: boolean; readonly condition?: boolean }
columns.doc: `false`: not filterable. `kind`: the filter kind whose UI the column shows (a built-in or a custom kind's name). `floating`: a box in the floating filter row (`@dzgrid/dom/filters`; the grid's `filters({ floating })` otherwise, `false` keeps this column out). `debounceMs`: the pause before what is typed there applies (150 in the browser, 300 on a server by default). `ops`: the operators its popup offers, in this order (the kind's own list when absent). `optionPart`: the `filterOption` part painting each row of a set filter's list (feedback pass C). `exclude: false`: its set filter never writes an `exclude` filter, nor `blanks` (docs/behaviors/filter-set.md « Include only »). `start: 'empty'`: its set list opens with nothing ticked when no filter is in force, and nothing ticked is no filter (default `'all'`); `selectAll: false`: no « Select all » box (filter-set.md « Starting empty »). Phase 9 (docs/behaviors/filter-combined.md, filter-multi.md): `maxConditions` 1 to 5, the rows its popup offers (over `filters({ maxConditions })`); `matchCase`: a « Match case » box on each text row; `condition` (a set column): a condition above the list, both stored as a `combined` AND.

columns.name: headerAlign
columns.doc: The header title's place (presentation-settings.md 3, 1.9.0): over `align`, which the title follows by default (a number column's title at the end, as its cells).

columns.name: wrap
columns.doc: The cells' text wraps on several lines (Phase 6 step 9, docs/behaviors/auto-height.md 1): with `@dzgrid/dom/auto-height` the row grows to its tallest wrapped cell; without it, or under a fixed `rowHeight`, the text wraps and is clipped.

columns.name: ui
columns.type: { readonly cell?: string; readonly header?: string; readonly tooltip?: string; readonly cellClass?: (c: CellClassContext<T, V>) => string | null | undefined; readonly headerClass?: string; readonly data?: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>> }
columns.doc: Parts by name for this column (a cell renderer, a header, a tooltip): plain names, resolved by the grid's registry. `cellClass` (step 26, docs/behaviors/cell-class.md): classes for a body cell from its data, space-separated (null: none). `headerClass` (showcase themes step 6): classes for the column's header cell, space-separated. `data` (feedback pass D): the app's own plain data for its parts, delivered as is (`c.column.def.ui.data`, same reference) to every part of the column. Any other key is a warning `unknown-ui-key` from the DOM layer.

columns.name: headerTooltip
columns.doc: Shown over the header, already translated by the host.

columns.name: tooltip
columns.type: (value: V | null, row: Readonly<T>, context: unknown) => string | null
columns.doc: `context`: the grid's `settings.context` (step 21).

columns.name: merge
columns.type: true | ((a: SpanCtx<T>, b: SpanCtx<T>) => boolean) | { readonly same?: (a: SpanCtx<T>, b: SpanCtx<T>) => boolean; readonly within?: readonly string[] }
columns.doc: Consecutive rows with the same value show one tall cell (docs/behaviors/spans.md). `true` compares the values' stable text; a function decides; `within` cuts a run where the listed columns change. Needs the spans feature; the base ignores it.

columns.name: rowSpan
columns.doc: How many rows this cell covers, from the data (1 when absent). Needs the spans feature.

columns.name: colSpan
columns.doc: How many columns this cell covers, from the data (1 when absent). Needs the spans feature.

columns.name: groupShow
columns.doc: Under a collapsible group (header-groups.md 1): shown only while it is open (`'open'`) or closed (`'closed'`); absent, in both. Ignored under a group that does not open and close.

columns.name: csv
columns.doc: `'text'`: in a CSV file, a digits-only value is written `="0123"` so Excel keeps it as text (csv-export.md).

columns.name: editable
columns.doc: Whether a data row's cell can be edited (editing.md 1): `true`, or a rule told the row and the grid's `settings.context`; only `true` means yes. Never a detail, filler or loading row.

columns.name: validate
columns.type: (value: V | null, row: Readonly<T>, context: unknown) => string | null | undefined
columns.doc: A refusal code (`validation.<code>` in the DOM's messages) or null: run by `@dzgrid/core/edit` after the column's `edit` checks (edit-validation.md 1). Synchronous only (owner S3-O1).

columns.name: edit
columns.doc: The simple checks of a kept value (owner S3-O3), run by `@dzgrid/core/edit`; the base reads none of it.
